subject: Matemática
description_pt: Compreender a ideia de variável, representada por letra ou símbolo, para expressar relação entre duas grandezas, diferenciando-a da ideia de incógnita.

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre o uso de letra como variável e seu uso como incógnita
components.description_en: Distinguish between the use of a letter as a variable and its use as an unknown
components.cc_component_description: Use variables to represent an unknown number or any number in a specified set, depending on the context

components.description_pt: Interpretar uma variável como quantidade que pode assumir múltiplos valores em relação
components.description_en: Interpret a variable as a quantity that can take multiple values in a relationship
components.cc_component_description: Represent a real-world situation by writing an equation that expresses the dependent variable in terms of the independent variable

components.description_pt: Expressar a relação entre duas grandezas usando variável em notação algébrica
components.description_en: Express the relationship between two quantities using a variable in algebraic notation
components.cc_component_description: Represent a quantitative relationship between two variables using an equation or expression

cc_matches.description: Use variables to represent numbers and write expressions when solving a real-world or mathematical problem; understand that a variable can represent an unknown number, or, depending on the purpose at hand, any number in a specified set.

Use variables to represent two quantities in a real-world problem that change in relationship to one another; write an equation to express one quantity, thought of as the dependent variable, in terms of the other quantity, thought of as the independent variable. Analyze the relationship between the dependent and independent variables using graphs and tables, and relate these to the equation. *For example, in a problem involving motion at constant speed, list and graph ordered pairs of distances and times, and write the equation d = 65t to represent the relationship between distance and time.*

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que possam ser representados por equações polinomiais de 1º grau, redutíveis à forma ax + b = c, fazendo uso das propriedades da igualdade.
